## Machine Learning Projects

::: {.card-box}

### Personal Information Extraction From Bangla Speech Signal Using MFCC and GMM  
**BSc Thesis | Machine Learning**

* Developed a machine learning model to extract personal information from Bangla speech signals.
* Applied **MFCC feature extraction** and **Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM)** for speech analysis.
* Implemented the system using Python-based machine learning tools.

[View Thesis](https://dspace.bracu.ac.bd:8443/xmlui/bitstream/handle/10361/14744/14101037%2c%2014101033%2c%2014101007_CSE.pdf?sequence=1){target="_blank"}

:::

::: {.card-box}

### Autonomous Grid-Following Robot Using Sensor-Based Navigation  
**Capstone Project | Robotics**

* Designed a sensor-based robot capable of navigating grid paths autonomously.
* Implemented obstacle detection and navigation using embedded sensors.
* Integrated microcontroller-based control for real-time movement decisions.

:::
